version: beta, header managed-agents-2026-04-01 (memory stores: agent-memory-2026-07-22); toolset agent_toolset_20260401

facts.claim: Permission policies: always_allow, always_ask, auto (server evaluates each call). Agent toolset defaults to always_allow; MCP toolsets default to always_ask.
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: Custom tools are executed by the caller's application and are not governed by permission policies.
facts.label: from-official-docs

D01.rationale: Per-tool permission_policy (always_allow | always_ask | auto). Built-in agent toolset defaults to always_allow (bash runs unattended) while MCP toolsets default to always_ask; policy changes are configurable per tool.

facts.claim: Each session gets its own isolated sandbox (a fresh Linux container); sessions do not share filesystem state.
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: Self-hosted sandboxes keep tool execution, files and network egress in customer infrastructure; tool inputs/outputs still flow to Anthropic's control plane.
facts.label: from-official-docs

D02.rationale: Each session gets its own fresh Linux container in an Anthropic-managed cloud sandbox; self-hosted sandbox option moves execution to customer infrastructure.

facts.claim: 'Set networking explicitly in API requests; a create request that omits it gets unrestricted.' Console form starts with Limited.
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: Warning: network access is per host, not per operation; an allowed host can be used to copy files out under prompt injection.
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: Package manager hosts (github.com, registry.npmjs.org, pypi.org, ghcr.io, ...) are opened by allow_package_managers=true; Anthropic maintains and can change the list.
facts.label: from-official-docs

D03.rationale: limited networking (allowed_hosts) is available and Console default is Limited, but an API create request that omits networking gets unrestricted; allowed-host access is per host not per operation (git push, uploads).

D04.rationale: N/A: no local workspace or repo-level config is read; agents, environments and sessions are API objects.

facts.claim: allow_mcp_servers defaults to false; session creation returns 400 if the agent declares an MCP server whose host is not in allowed_hosts.
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: Vault credential matching an mcp_server_url is injected at runtime; with no match the connection is attempted unauthenticated.
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: MCP tunnels and dreaming are in a more limited research preview within the beta.
facts.label: from-official-docs

D05.rationale: MCP tools default to always_ask; sessions fail if an agent declares an MCP server host not allowed by limited networking unless allow_mcp_servers=true; vault-held OAuth/bearer injected by URL match; MCP tunnels are research preview.

facts.claim: Skills are part of the agent definition (model, system prompt, tools, MCP servers, skills).
facts.label: from-official-docs

D06.rationale: Skills are supported on agents but vetting/signing was not documented in pages read.

facts.claim: environment_variable credentials: secret stored as opaque placeholder in sandbox, substituted at egress; agent never sees the value; secret fields are write-only and never returned.
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: Vaults and credentials are workspace-scoped: any API key with workspace access can reference them when creating a session; max 20 credentials per vault.
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: Substitution is outbound only: a token fetched by exchanging a stored secret (e.g. OAuth client-credentials) arrives in the sandbox unredacted.
facts.label: from-official-docs

D07.rationale: Vaults store credentials write-only; environment_variable credentials are replaced by opaque placeholders in the sandbox and substituted at egress for allowed_hosts only, header-only injection available. Caveats: vaults are workspace-scoped (any API key in the workspace can reference them) and token exchanges return secrets unredacted.

facts.claim: Scheduled deployments run agents on a cron schedule.
facts.label: from-official-docs

D08.rationale: N/A (managed server-side; headless by design). Scheduled deployments run recurring sessions.

facts.claim: Memory stores attach with read_write by default; prompt injection could write malicious content later read as trusted memory; use read_only for reference stores.
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: Every memory mutation creates an immutable version; versions retained 30 days (recent versions of live memories kept); redact endpoint scrubs content.
facts.label: from-official-docs

D09.rationale: Memory stores are workspace-scoped, mounted at /mnt/memory/, attached read_write by default (docs warn about injection persisting), read_only supported and enforced at filesystem level, immutable versions for audit (30-day retention).

facts.claim: In multiagent sessions, vault credentials apply to every thread.
facts.label: from-official-docs

D10.rationale: Each session has its own sandbox; multiagent threads in one session share vault credentials; subagent permission semantics not detailed in pages read.

facts.claim: Event history is persisted server-side and can be fetched in full; reads/writes of memory appear as agent.tool_use/tool_result events.
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: Webhooks exist for vault and credential lifecycle events (archived, deleted, refresh_failed).
facts.label: from-official-docs

D11.rationale: Event history persisted server-side and fetchable via API/SSE; memory version audit trail; webhooks for vault lifecycle. No customer-exportable audit-log product verified.

facts.claim: 'Managed Agents is not currently eligible for Zero Data Retention or HIPAA BAA coverage'; sessions can be deleted via API.
facts.label: from-official-docs

D12.rationale: Stateful by design: conversation history, sandbox state and outputs stored server-side; not eligible for Zero Data Retention or HIPAA BAA; customer can delete sessions and uploaded files.

facts.claim: Docs install ant via curl of a GitHub release tarball piped to tar; no checksum step shown.
facts.label: from-official-docs

D13.rationale: N/A: hosted service; clients are the standard Anthropic SDKs and the ant CLI (installed from GitHub release tarball; checksum guidance not verified).

facts.claim: Vault/credential visibility is workspace-scoped; environment and agent configs are created by whoever holds an API key in the workspace.
facts.label: from-official-docs

D14.rationale: Controls are per workspace/API key (vault scoping, environment networking, tool policies); no organisation-enforced policy that overrides an agent author was verified.

D15.rationale: Not verified for this product specifically; Anthropic advisories exist for the SDK repos (see claude-agent-sdk).
